$comment: Advisories a dependency carries with no patched version to move to. Each names its reason and the date it is looked at again; an expired one fails lint:dependency-advisories until it is fixed or renewed.

exceptions.reason: No version of braces is patched (3.0.3 is the latest and is affected). It reaches the tree through micromatch in build and test tooling, where every pattern is the repository's own.

No version of deepmerge is patched (4.3.1 is the latest and is affected). It reaches the tree only through webfont, which builds the VS Code extension's icon font from the repository's own SVGs and configuration.

No version of picomatch is patched (4.0.7 is the latest and is affected). It reaches the tree only through build, site-generation and test tooling (astro, vite, vitest, tinyglobby, micromatch, anymatch, @parcel/watcher), where every glob pattern is the repository's own, never user input.
